The
Atlantic
puffin

a

in

on
rocky
cliffs

ocean
.

bird
often
allows
other
species
to
share
its
habitat
without
much
conflict
.
However
,
it
must
be
cautious
of
natural
predators
like
seagulls

might
steal
its
food
.
The
puffins
often
cooperate
with
each
other

birds

safe

raising
awareness
.

introduced
a
new
public

of
wildlife
protection
